table_sql.client_sessions:
CREATE TABLE client_sessions (
  id                            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision                      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
  created_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  goal_id                       TEXT,
  task_id                       TEXT,
  run_id                        TEXT,
  writer_epoch                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (writer_epoch >= 1),
  writer_client_id              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(writer_client_id) >= 1),
  lease_expires_at              TEXT,
  event_watermark               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_watermark >= 0),
  upstream_session_id           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(upstream_session_id) >= 1),
  upstream_log_id               TEXT,
  upstream_log_hash             TEXT CHECK (upstream_log_hash IS NULL OR (length(upstream_log_hash) = 71 AND upstream_log_hash GLOB 'sha256:[0-9a-f]*')),
  workspace_ref                 TEXT,
  title                         TEXT,
  model_config_ref              TEXT,
  core_build_id                 TEXT,
  transcript_artifact_id        TEXT,
  resume_requires_explicit_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resume_requires_explicit_user IN (0,1)),
  sealed_at                     TEXT,
  archived_at                   TEXT,
  protocol                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'researchos-client/2' CHECK (protocol = 'researchos-client/2')
)
table_sql.idempotency: CREATE TABLE idempotency(principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, headers TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,operation,key))
table_sql.host_model_configurations:
CREATE TABLE host_model_configurations (
 model_config_ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(model_config_ref)>0),
 owner_host_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(owner_host_ref)=17 AND substr(owner_host_ref,1,5)='host-' AND substr(owner_host_ref,6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 principal TEXT NOT NULL,
 config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(config_revision)='integer' AND config_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
 canonical_config_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(canonical_config_json) AND json_type(canonical_config_json)='object'),
 config_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(config_hash)=71 AND substr(config_hash,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(config_hash,8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 operation_scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(operation_scope_json) AND json_type(operation_scope_json)='object'),
 scope_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_hash)=71 AND substr(scope_hash,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(scope_hash,8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(created_at)>0),
 CHECK(json_extract(canonical_config_json,'$.config_revision')=config_revision),
 UNIQUE(owner_host_ref,principal,config_revision),
 UNIQUE(owner_host_ref,principal,config_revision,model_config_ref),
 UNIQUE(principal,command_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(principal,command_id,request_hash)
  REFERENCES client_command_identities(principal,command_id,request_hash)
  DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)
table_sql.runtime_bindings:
CREATE TABLE runtime_bindings (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL,
    profile_ref TEXT NOT NULL, profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    technical_hash TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,runtime)
)
table_sql.runtime_qualification_plans:
CREATE TABLE runtime_qualification_plans (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, runtime TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan TEXT NOT NULL, plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    author TEXT NOT NULL, author_root TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,task)
)
table_sql.runtime_qualification_runs:
CREATE TABLE runtime_qualification_runs (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL,
    runtime TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
    plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL, profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL, input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_bundle TEXT NOT NULL, owner_root TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project,task), UNIQUE(project,run)
)
table_sql.runtime_dispatches:
CREATE TABLE runtime_dispatches (
    project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dispatch_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    manifest TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','OBSERVED','UNKNOWN')),
    worker TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', journal_locator TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    identity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    observation_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    observation_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    prepared_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY(project,run,epoch)
)
table_sql.resource_effects: CREATE TABLE resource_effects(project TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL, effect_key TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), PRIMARY KEY(project,run,effect_key,sequence))
table_sql.domain_objects:
CREATE TABLE domain_objects (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)), content_hash TEXT, immutable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(project,kind,id), UNIQUE(project,kind,id,revision)
)
